summary_zh: 泰中簽署八項合作文件，涵蓋EV產業投資、汽車產業升級與勞工技能/職業教育，對在泰華商而言，自動化與人才升級壓力持續。工業部擬強化邊境礦物進出口管制以防跨境污染，環保合規要求趨嚴；BOI與長城汽車(GWM)Sourcing Day促成71組零件配對，國產化比例提升帶來供應商認證壓力。
summary_en: Thailand-China signed eight cooperation documents covering EV investment, auto upgrading and skills training, keeping automation and talent pressure high. Industry ministry plans tighter border mineral controls against cross-border pollution; BOI-GWM Sourcing Day made 71 matches to raise local parts content.
